name: card
summary: A surface that groups one thing's content: a title, a description, an action beside them, a body and a footer.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: outline is a bordered surface in the theme's card colours; plain has no frame or padding.

slots.name: action
slots.description: One control beside the title, such as Edit. It goes under the title at the largest text sizes.

slots.name: footer
slots.description: A row at the bottom for buttons or a timestamp.

states.name: rest
states.description: The variant's surface. The card itself is not pressable; its controls are.

accessibility.name: Its title, which is a heading.
accessibility.web: A <div> (or article, section, li) with the title as a heading.
accessibility.apple: The title has the header trait; the action is its own button.
accessibility.windows: UI Automation ControlType.Group named by its title; the title is a Text with heading level 2; the action keeps its own control.

cases.person: A bordered card titled Pantry, with an Edit button beside the title.

deviations: With href the whole card is one link named by its title; native cards are not links.
